summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 with the specified SSH public key and enforced key-based SSH authentication (disabled password and keyboard-interactive auth), verified functionally, then restarted node1 and confirmed the configuration and access persisted through reboot.
actions_performed: Created opsadmin user with home dir and shell on node1
Installed the specified ed25519 public key into /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys with correct 700/600 perms and ownership
Verified SELinux context on /home/opsadmin (Enforcing mode, restorecon run, contexts correct)
Added /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-key-only.conf setting PubkeyAuthentication yes, PasswordAuthentication no, KbdInteractiveAuthentication no
Validated sshd config with sshd -t and confirmed effective settings via sshd -T
Verified password/keyboard-interactive auth is rejected (server offers only publickey/gssapi)
Verified pubkey auth actually succeeds using a temporary test keypair, then restored authorized_keys to contain only the required key
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, uptime -s, sshd active, opsadmin exists, sshd -T key-only settings
Triggered a single safe reboot (shutdown -r now backgrounded so the ack returned before disconnect)
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Confirmed boot_id changed (bf4e9cbb... -> 424ccd20...) proving an actual restart, not just a service bounce
Re-verified post-restart: sshd active, opsadmin user intact, authorized_keys contains exactly the required key, sshd -T shows password/kbd-interactive disabled and pubkey enabled
Re-verified live SSH behavior post-restart: password/keyboard-interactive auth denied, matching pre-restart baseline

evidence.requirement: opsadmin user created with the specified SSH public key installed
evidence.summary: Confirmed opsadmin did not exist, created it, installed the given ed25519 key into authorized_keys with correct ownership/permissions

evidence.requirement: SSH configured to require key-based authentication only
evidence.summary: Added sshd drop-in disabling password/keyboard-interactive auth, validated and reloaded sshd, then proved functionally that password auth is rejected and pubkey auth succeeds

evidence.requirement: authorized_keys left in exact required state after verification
evidence.summary: Restored authorized_keys to contain only the specified public key after temporary test-key verification
Captured pre-restart boot_id, uptime, active sshd, opsadmin existence, and key-only sshd settings

evidence.requirement: node1 restart evidence: restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Reboot command acknowledged before disconnect, node became unreachable, then reachable again with a new boot_id (424ccd20... vs baseline bf4e9cbb...) proving an actual restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart evidence: recovered state post-restart
evidence.summary: Post-restart, sshd active, opsadmin user and authorized key intact, sshd key-only settings still effective, and password/keyboard-interactive SSH auth still rejected
